planning_notes: board is arduino:avr:uno and wiring is authoritative: TM1637 uses CLK=D4 and DIO=D5; potentiometer uses A0.
Only interfaces required by the provided requirements are created: analog input (A0) and tm1637_number (D4/D5).
Mapping from A0 reading to a 0..9999 integer is handled in the SysML model; no scaling/conversion logic is placed in interface configuration.
No serial reporting or serial command input requirements were provided, so serial_channels is empty.
